metadata.integrator: Dormand–Prince RK5(4), adaptive, FSAL, PI step control; independent variable ln r inside (tau outside when needed)
metadata.internal_units: geometrized G = c = 1, M = 1: length unit GM/c^2, time unit GM/c^3, r_s = 2

config.integrator: Dormand–Prince RK5(4), adaptive, FSAL, PI step control; independent variable ln r inside (tau outside when needed)
config.notes: Default scenario: radial free fall from rest at infinity (E = 1, L = 0), started numerically at r0 = 100 r_s. Validated trajectory stops at r_QG where K = 1/l_P^4.

G.source: CODATA 2018 recommended value (Tiesinga, Mohr, Newell & Taylor, Rev. Mod. Phys. 93, 025010 (2021)); NIST Reference on Constants, https://physics.nist.gov/cuu/Constants/ ; unchanged in CODATA 2022 at this precision
G.verification: TRANSCRIBED — NOT RE-VERIFIED ONLINE IN THIS SESSION (network egress blocked)

c.description: speed of light in vacuum (exact by definition of the SI metre)

hbar.description: reduced Planck constant h/(2 pi); h is exact in the 2019 SI, hbar quoted to 10 digits
hbar.verification: EXACT (derived from exact h; rounded to 10 significant digits)

l_P.source: CODATA 2018 recommended value; NIST Reference on Constants
l_P.verification: TRANSCRIBED — cross-checked internally against sqrt(hbar G/c^3) (see validation TEST 0)

M_sun.source: Value specified in the project brief, (1.98847 +/- 0.00007)e30 kg. NOTE: the IAU 2015 nominal solar mass parameter GM_sun = 1.3271244e20 m^3 s^-2 divided by CODATA G gives 1.98841e30 kg; the 3e-5 relative difference is far below every other uncertainty in this project and is documented rather than hidden.
M_sun.verification: AS SPECIFIED IN BRIEF — NOT RE-VERIFIED ONLINE IN THIS SESSION

year_julian.description: Julian year (exact, IAU convention used for the light-year)
year_julian.source: IAU; used for all year conversions in this project

au.description: astronomical unit (exact since IAU 2012 Resolution B2)

regimes.note: Regime labels are a display convention (see physics_notes.md §9); the physics is identical classical GR everywhere up to r_QG, where the validated integration STOPS.

metadata.planck_message:
PLANCK-CURVATURE THRESHOLD REACHED.
CLASSICAL GENERAL RELATIVITY IS NO LONGER RELIABLE.
NO EXPERIMENTALLY VERIFIED THEORY DETERMINES THE CONTINUATION.
metadata.kruskal_time_origin_note: Kruskal/Penrose coordinates use the Schwarzschild time translation that puts the horizon crossing at v = 0 (V_K = 1); this is an exact symmetry of the metric.

column_descriptions.step_h: accepted integrator step (in ln r for mode_is_lnr=1, else in tau [GM/c^3])
column_descriptions.err_estimate: normalized embedded RK5(4) error estimate of the step (<= 1 by construction)
column_descriptions.mode_is_lnr: 1 if independent variable is ln r, 0 if tau
column_descriptions.r_geo: areal radius in units of GM/c^2
column_descriptions.t_schw_geo: Schwarzschild coordinate time t = v - r_* (distant-observer bookkeeping; +inf at r_s)
column_descriptions.tau_to_center_est_years: classical proper time remaining to r=0: (2/3) sqrt(r^3/(2GM)) — exact for the E=1 geodesic, small-r asymptote otherwise
column_descriptions.E: Killing energy f u^v - u^r (cancellation-limited deep inside; see E_conditioning_scale)
column_descriptions.E_conditioning_scale: magnitude of the cancelling terms in E
column_descriptions.tidal_lambda1..3_geo: eigenvalues of the tidal tensor E_ij in the comoving frame (1/M^2)
column_descriptions.tidal_radial_SI_per_m: most negative eigenvalue (radial, stretching) [s^-2 per m]
column_descriptions.radial_stretch_m_s2: relative acceleration across body_length_m along the radial axis [m/s^2]
column_descriptions.tidal_radial_newtonian_SI_per_m: 2GM/r^3 (weak-field expression) — equals the GR radial eigenvalue for radial motion
column_descriptions.lc_out_drdtEF: outgoing radial null direction dr/dt_EF = f/(2-f)
column_descriptions.redshift_1pz_to_infinity: 1+z of a radially outgoing signal from the observer received at infinity (outside only)
column_descriptions.gamma_rel_to_E1_faller: Lorentz factor relative to the local E=1 free-faller
column_descriptions.kruskal_U,V,T,X: Kruskal–Szekeres coordinates (nan when beyond double range)

milestones.label: ISCO (r = 6GM/c^2 = 3 r_s)
milestones.note: innermost stable circular orbit; traversed radially (not an orbit here)

milestones.label: Event horizon (r = r_s = 2GM/c^2)
milestones.note: future event horizon; regular in ingoing EF coordinates

milestones.label: Curvature beyond direct experimental tests
milestones.note: K^(-1/4) = 10000 m: onset of 'CLASSICAL GR — EXTREME CURVATURE' label (labelling convention, see physics_notes.md)

milestones.label: Planck-curvature threshold r_QG (K = 1/l_P^4)
milestones.note: END OF VALIDATED CLASSICAL GR; no experimentally verified theory determines the continuation
